alertKindNotFromInbox: This kind of notification isn't written from the project inbox
alertRecipientOutside: The recipient isn't in this project or channel
decisionNeedsOptions: A decision request needs at least two options; when there is nothing to choose, send a change alert (change_alert) instead
notificationNoRecipients: This notification has no recipients: the channel's roster only has AI teammates (or the project has no members or owner yet). Name a person and send it again
notificationOnlyDecisions: Only a decision request can be decided
notificationOptionNotOffered: The chosen option isn't one of the candidates
